engine: Kokoro-82M (open model, Apache-2.0 licence, run locally)
previous_choice: ElevenLabs 'Simone' (not used: the free plan is not licensed for commercial use)
how_it_works: Every sentence Pip can say is split by src/speech.js into whole-sentence, phrase and number clips. narration/audio holds the recorded clips as audio sprites plus map.json; build.js copies them into dist/audio and embeds the map. Sentences without clips fall back to the device voice. narration/record.py makes the recordings: it records only clips the app needs and does not have yet, or every clip with --all after a voice change.
disclosure: Pip tells children his voice is made by a computer; the privacy notice says the voice is AI-generated audio included in the app.
previous_voice: af_heart (American English, female), Nov 3 to Nov 27, 2026
